title: Chocolate Gingerbread Slabs
method: Preheat oven to 170°C (150°C Fan / Gas Mark 3) and line the base and sides of a 30 x 20 x 5cm roasting tin with baking parchment[cite: 16].
In a saucepan, melt 175g unsalted butter with dark muscovado sugar, caster sugar, golden syrup, black treacle, cloves, cinnamon, and ground ginger[cite: 16].
Dissolve bicarbonate of soda in 2 tablespoons warm water[cite: 16].
Take saucepan off heat and beat in eggs, milk, and dissolved bicarb mixture[cite: 16].
Stir in plain flour and 40g cocoa powder using a wooden spoon until combined, then fold in chocolate chips[cite: 16].
Pour batter into prepared tin and bake for about 45 minutes until risen and firm, remaining slightly damp beneath the set top[cite: 16].
Cool cake completely in the tin on a wire rack[cite: 16].
Sift icing sugar into a bowl[cite: 16]. In a heavy-based saucepan, heat 30g unsalted butter, 1 tbsp cocoa, and 60ml ginger ale until butter melts, then whisk in icing sugar until smooth[cite: 16].
Remove cake from tin, unwrap paper, pour icing over top, and cut into slabs once set[cite: 16].
